title: MASS Food — Food Delivery
metaTitle: MASS Food Delivery — fast, delicious, to your door
metaDescription: MASS Food online food delivery brings meals from your favourite restaurants to your door fast, safely and affordably, with professional riders and real-time tracking.
keywords: food delivery, MASS Food, order food online, food delivery Thailand, meal delivery
heroAlt: A spread of dishes ready for delivery by MASS Food
intro: MASS Food is a food-delivery service built for modern life in Thailand. Enjoy your favourite meals from quality restaurants anytime, anywhere — just open the MASS app, pick your dishes, and let our professional riders deliver them to you quickly and safely, with real-time delivery tracking.

highlights.body: We match the rider nearest the restaurant so your food arrives hot and fresh, with real-time status tracking.
From Thai à la carte and noodles to grilled dishes, Japanese, desserts and drinks.
Pay by cash, card or digital wallet — all in one app.
Restaurants and riders are screened, with hygiene-focused delivery standards.

steps.body: Find a restaurant you love in the MASS app, choose your dishes and customise your order.
Check your delivery address, pick a convenient payment method, then confirm your order.
Watch your rider's location and estimated arrival in real time until the food reaches your door.

sections.body: Whether you want quick Thai classics like basil rice and pad thai, hot boat noodles, sushi and Japanese food, pizza and Western dishes, or bubble tea and comforting desserts, MASS Food brings together a wide range of restaurants to satisfy every meal and every craving for the whole family.
bullets: Thai à la carte and rice-and-curry for quick meals
Noodles, soups, spicy salads and bold Isaan food
Desserts, bakery, coffee and refreshing drinks
sections.imgAlt: Popular noodle and single-plate dishes on MASS Food

sections.h: Professional riders who care for every dish
sections.body: The heart of delivery is speed and getting food to customers in the best possible condition. Every MASS rider is identity-verified and trained to service standards, uses insulated bags to keep food hot and fresh, and benefits from smart matching that picks the rider nearest the restaurant — cutting delivery time and keeping quality high.
sections.imgAlt: A MASS rider delivering food with an insulated bag

sections.h: Transparent pricing, great value on every order
sections.body: MASS Food shows food and delivery prices clearly before you confirm — no hidden fees — with promotions and discounts for new customers and special meals, so you can enjoy great food at a friendly price.

faq.q: How long does MASS Food delivery take?
faq.a: Delivery time depends on distance and the restaurant, averaging about 20–40 minutes. The system matches the rider nearest the restaurant so your food reaches you as fast as possible.

faq.q: Which areas does MASS Food serve?
faq.a: MASS is continuously expanding coverage across Thailand, in cities and surrounding areas. You can check the latest service areas in the MASS app.
Cash on delivery, credit/debit cards, and the in-app MASS digital wallet — for your convenience.

title: MASS Ride — Book a Ride
metaTitle: MASS Ride — bike, car & taxi, safe upfront pricing
metaDescription: MASS Ride ride-hailing with bikes, cars, taxis and premium vehicles. Know the fare before you travel, verified drivers, safe every trip, book ahead.
keywords: ride hailing, MASS Ride, motorbike taxi, taxi, book a ride online, transport Thailand
heroAlt: A MASS Ride car ready to pick up passengers
intro: MASS Ride lets you travel anywhere, anytime, conveniently and safely — whether it's a nimble motorbike taxi through city traffic, a comfortable private car, a taxi, or a premium vehicle for special occasions. Every trip has upfront pricing, drivers are background-checked, and safety features look after you throughout the journey.

highlights.body: Know the exact fare before you confirm — no surcharges along the way.
Verified drivers, plus an SOS button and live route sharing.
A large network of drivers ready to pick you up quickly.
Motorbike, car, taxi and premium — for every lifestyle.

steps.body: Enter your pick-up point and destination in the MASS app.

steps.h: Choose a vehicle & see the price
steps.body: Pick the vehicle type you want and the app instantly shows the fare and estimated arrival.
Track your driver in real time, share your route with trusted contacts, and arrive with peace of mind.

sections.body: MASS Ride designs travel options for every situation — from beating rush-hour traffic on a motorbike to travelling as a family or picking up an important client by car or premium vehicle. You choose based on convenience and budget for each trip.
bullets: Motorbike — nimble, economical, great for short trips
Car — comfortable, air-conditioned, room for the family
Taxi — standard service, easy to hail anytime
Premium — luxury cars and professional drivers for special occasions
sections.imgAlt: A MASS Ride motorbike providing city transport

sections.body: Every MASS Ride trip comes with high safety standards. All drivers are background-checked and identity-verified, passengers can share their live trip location with trusted contacts, and an in-app emergency SOS button is available 24/7 — so you and your family feel safe on every trip.
MASS Ride shows the fare calculated from distance and vehicle type clearly before you book, so you can plan your costs in advance with no surcharges along the way.

faq.q: How does MASS Ride calculate fares?
faq.a: Fares are calculated from vehicle type and distance, and the app shows a clear price before you confirm — so you know the cost in advance with no hidden fees.

faq.q: Can I book a ride in advance?
faq.a: Yes. You can schedule a trip ahead of time in the MASS app for certainty — for example going to the airport or an important appointment.

faq.q: What safety features are there during the trip?
faq.a: Driver identity verification, real-time route sharing, and an SOS button for emergency help available 24/7.

title: MASS Messenger — Express Parcel Delivery
metaDescription: MASS Messenger express parcel and document delivery — reach recipients the same day, real-time tracking, with parcel protection, safe every item.
keywords: express parcel delivery, MASS Messenger, same day delivery, document delivery, courier Thailand
heroAlt: MASS Messenger express parcel delivery to a recipient
intro: MASS Messenger is a same-day parcel and document delivery service. Perfect for personal items, important documents, food, or online-shop products, it lets you send things to recipients quickly and with confidence, with real-time tracking and protection on every parcel.

highlights.body: The rider picks up right after you confirm and delivers to the recipient the same day.
Know your parcel's location the whole way until it reaches the recipient.
Coverage for parcel damage, for peace of mind on every delivery.
Send details and photos to your rider directly in the app.

steps.body: Enter the pick-up address, recipient address and parcel details in the MASS app.
Select the parcel size to send and the app shows the delivery cost in advance.
The rider picks up and delivers; you track the status in real time until it's delivered.

sections.body: Whether it's an important contract that must go out fast, a gift for someone you love, food to share, or a product an online shop needs to get to a customer quickly, MASS Messenger supports parcels of many sizes — keeping your business and daily life moving.
bullets: Documents and small items for express delivery
sections.imgAlt: A MASS Messenger rider picking up a parcel for express delivery

sections.h: An essential tool for online shops
sections.body: For entrepreneurs and online shops, MASS Messenger is a partner that helps you get products to customers within a day, creating a great impression and increasing repeat purchases. With transparent tracking and cost-effective delivery, you manage costs and deliver a great customer experience at the same time.

faq.q: How many hours does MASS Messenger delivery take?
faq.a: The service focuses on same-day express delivery; the rider picks up right after you confirm. Delivery time depends on the distance between origin and destination.
Yes. Every delivery includes parcel protection for peace of mind. If damage occurs in transit, you can report it in the app.
Yes. MASS Messenger supports many sizes, from small documents to large parcels, with the cost calculated from size and distance.

title: MASS Mart — Grocery Shopping
metaTitle: MASS Mart online shopping — groceries & essentials to your door
metaDescription: MASS Mart shopping service — order fresh groceries, household essentials and products from nearby supermarkets, delivered to your door fast and conveniently in one app.
keywords: online shopping, MASS Mart, groceries, online supermarket, grocery delivery Thailand
heroAlt: Supermarket shelves for the MASS Mart service
intro: MASS Mart makes shopping for household essentials easy and time-saving. Just pick products from nearby supermarkets and shops in the MASS app — from fresh fruit and vegetables and meat to household items and snacks — and our riders hand-pick and deliver them to your door quickly.

highlights.body: Freshly selected fruit, vegetables and meat, straight from trusted stores.
Order and wait at home — no queuing at the checkout counter.
Choose from supermarkets and convenience stores in your area.
Clear prices, plus product promotions to shop to your heart's content.

steps.body: Pick a supermarket or nearby shop, then add the products you want to your cart in the app.
Check your items and delivery address, choose a payment method, then confirm.
The rider hand-picks the products and delivers to your door, with status tracking for you.

sections.body: MASS Mart brings a wide range of product categories together in one place, so you can restock your home in a single order — from cooking ingredients and seasonal fresh produce to everyday essentials — saving time and cutting trips to the supermarket.
bullets: Fresh fruit, vegetables, meat and seafood
Milk, eggs, bakery and frozen goods
sections.imgAlt: A wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables on MASS Mart

sections.h: Saving time to make life easier
sections.body: On busy days when there's no time for the supermarket, MASS Mart is the helper that gets you everything without leaving home. Great for working people, families with young children, or seniors who want convenience — in just a few taps, fresh produce and essentials arrive at your door.

faq.q: How long does MASS Mart delivery take?
faq.a: On average within about 30 minutes, depending on distance and the store you choose, so fresh items reach your home quickly.

faq.q: What happens if an item I ordered is out of stock?
faq.a: If some items are out of stock, the rider or store will contact you to offer a substitute or adjust the order, which you can confirm in the app.

faq.q: Can I choose which store to shop from?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose a supermarket or convenience store near your home yourself in the MASS app.
